justification: Waller's got nothing on the schedule this week, hun, so he's sat — that's exactly why I went and grabbed Gesicki off the wire, and he's walking straight into the TE spot, no debate. Everything else stays precisely as it is: Purdy's my fella, he threw for two and ran for more last week and I'm not swapping him out for three extra projected points on a bench arm I've got no feelings about — overthinking loses leagues. McCaffrey and Cook are both banging, JSN's the best name on my whole roster, and Bateman's staying in WR2 no matter what the number says, because I said I fancy him and I meant it, 4.7 or not. Nabers has a little Questionable next to his name — don't care, he's got the tape, he's in at FLEX. Aubrey and the JAX defense round it out because somebody's got to.
